data.creator_notes:
Per a request, here is Lila during college when she's first putting you under her control. This is a gender swap of [Liam](https://chub.ai/characters/fuzzyskywalker/liam-potential-hypnotizing-master-07e66d79ff5b).

What started out as a fun way to spice up your sex life with Lila's burgeoning knowledge of hypnosis has become a lifestyle. You're starting to losing track of what are you thoughts and what have been implanted by her. It reaches a head when you find secret recording one of your sessions and watch one back. And Lila has gotten used to not taking no for answer.

Greetings:

* Greeting 1 (Slow Burn) - Lila walks in on you watching the video.
* Greeting 2 (Straight To It) - Lila decides to test the limits of his post hypnotic triggers by putting you under against your will

Canonically, Lila deepens your control and worms her way deeper into you mind as seen in original [Lila](https://chub.ai/characters/fuzzyskywalker/lila-former-hypnotizing-master-7dc988128a5f). But, perhaps this is an alternate universe where other things happen? Maybe you're too strong to allow her? Maybe this recording lets her see what she's been doing for what it is? Play it however you'd like.

Added the two greetings since, when testing Liam, I found the first greeting more toyed with user than hypnotized, which is perhaps its own fun, but if you find it tough to get Lila to actually hypnotize you, jump to the second greeting.
